name: nested-sections-coverage-reconcile
body:
SPEC RECONCILIATION (nested-sections; feedback-18, feedback-20) [with user], amended by the spine-backfill pass [autonomous].

SOURCE: the nested-sections feature changes the section renderer, the template registry/loader and the slide parser. The spec was reconciled so its tier-3 components are scoped to the code each really owns and every plan requirement still reaches a solution node.

DESIGN DECISIONS RECORDED:
1. Render tier split by role. solution.component.renderer is the section renderer — it owns internal/render/render.go and executes templates and section instances bottom-up (RenderSlide, renderer.renderSection, renderer.slideData, parseLayouts, itemContext, deckContext). solution.component.deck-renderer is the whole-deck assembler — it owns internal/render/deck.go and applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode), vertical stacks, anchors and notes over the per-slide documents (RenderDeck). domain.service.render-sections is realised by renderer; domain.service.render-deck by deck-renderer (with deck-page). The four requirements item-context / section-template-context / template-context / template-language drive domain.service.render-sections; pdf-via-print / slide-metadata still drive domain.service.render-deck.
2. CLI split. solution.component.cli-templates is the templates command — it owns internal/cli/templates.go (runTemplates and its printers), the presentation half of domain.service.template-registry. solution.component.cli-commands owns the other commands (internal/cli/cli.go Run dispatch, init.go, initlibrary.go, start.go, cmd/kalide/main.go). domain.service.template-registry is realised by cli-templates and template-registry.
3. agent-guide dropped internal/scaffold.DefaultThemeCSS (a theme stylesheet is not agent-guide content) and keeps the guide writers it really owns (Init, InitExternal, InitLibrary, writeHelloSeed), which the init-seed scaffolder genuinely shares; see solution.note.spine-backfill-reconcile.
4. template.NewRegistryFromLibrary moved to solution.component.template-library-loader (the loader builds registries from the library's files); template-registry keeps NewRegistry / checkDeclaredName / CheckValues / NewFormat / manifest parsing and also owns template.LayoutFuncMap (the documented layout func map).

The earlier framing — that cli-templates and deck-renderer existed to satisfy a coverage gate by anchoring one function each — is superseded. The spine-backfill pass gave every non-test Go file under internal/ and cmd/ an explicit owner (0 unowned), so cli-templates and deck-renderer are now scoped to the files they name and the decomposition is the design, not a gate workaround (see solution.note.cli-templates-and-deck-renderer).

RESERVATIONS FOR THE HUMAN GATE:
- The four drive moves off domain.service.render-deck narrow those requirements' whole-deck render trace to the section renderer; deck-level assembly stays reachable via pdf-via-print / slide-metadata.
- No requirement or constraint text was changed.
